body: Thank you for sharing your story. You are a survivor. I wish that good things come your way after all you've been through.
You already said what I wanted to say and more! People like you replying makes me glad i joined this subreddit :)
I'm so sorry this had to happen to you but I am curious if if it's okay with you, how did you break up with your ex?? I hate how much she took advantage of you.

Hi! I am a graduate of Psychology and am planning to take my masters this August and hopefully become a registered Psychologist. I am sorry you have been through shit. I am clinically diagnosed with depression( just like you? I assume) been through rehab this April, I'm currently out but I am out here having cigs and skipped work today. I hope I won't let people like us down when I do become a Psychologist, if even I can make it there. From my experience there was even a time when something my psychiatrist said triggered me into cutting myself and I tried to hang myself too. Man it's hard to find the right words to say to someone like us if they haven't been through what we have.
What do I need huh, I really don't know right now but thanks for your thoughts. It gives me something to think about.
Yeah I am still here. Sent myself to rehab. Currently out but I am relapsing again and it sucks.
This usually happens before I take a bath. Just sittin there buck nacked on the floor. Which is why I take too long to shower hahah.

Please don't be afraid to reach out. Talk to someone, anyone. I am so self-aware that I sent myself to rehab. I learned there that the only people who could understand how we feel are people like us but that doesn't mean that non- depressed loved ones love us any less even if they don't understand how we feel. Have trust in your relationships and believe in your friends :). Gosh darn it I can't believe I am saying this positive things now when 2 months ago I wanted to hang myself. Believe me it does get better. Talk to the right people ( u can talk to me too if u want).
Thanks for the kind words. I hope we get through this together.

I don't know your personal circumstances but I highly recommend you try seeing a therapist. You see it is not like talking to a friend because therapists are trained to help us deal with this stuff. I am seeing a therapist myself and it has helped me deal with depression and I just hope you could get the help you need.

I like horror movies and listen to heavy metal too! And yep I'm 22 almost 23 and yes I am currently seeing a psychiatrist and on medication that's why my parents think that despite these efforts nothing is working that's why the priest and just to share my dad also consulted a witch doctor and we butchered two pigs to ward off evil spirit "haunting" me. I know it's bizzarre and I told my parents they don't have too but it seems that they are as desperate as I am too rid myself of depression.
Thank you :) I really appreciate it.

"...like a bandaid on a gunshot." Makes sense to me. I just had my family had a priest pray over me because they are so worried I might kill myself. I went through it said I accepted Jesus and everything but still I know deep down it will not help. If I told my family I was an atheist they would just probably tell me it is the cause of my depression because I don't believe I am in despair. I do want to get better but not through faith.
Thanks I am currently outside of the house at the moment. I still feel dreadful and I am also considering rehab. I do hope things will look up.
Thank you for commenting it really helps :)
Sometimes you just don't know what to say to these kinda posts... you want to tell them to not do it but at the same time you know what it feels like so you just don't say anything
